title: Act now or wait? How monetary policy should respond to supply shocks
summary: Whether a central bank should look through or respond to a supply shock depends on how long the inflationary effects of the shock will last. Yet persistence is often difficult to judge in real time. I find that acting early is preferable because waiting for clarity about persistence could require a larger—and more painful—monetary policy adjustment later.
